scope: CPU orchestration/report component; no qualified binary learner or result is bundled
token_definition: fixed conditioning slots, including masked slots; not DSL/code/reasoning tokens or tok/s
fold_assignment: one task-stratified family partition, seeded136; paired across arms/seeds; never tuned on outcomes
panel: 240 regression and240 binary; train-family panel contexts use that family's held-out model, novel families use full-train model
training_closure: only that job's train metadata and hash-pinned train-row summaries; no validation/evaluation references
elo: family-weighted Bradley-Terry,400 MM iterations,1e-4 tie margin,half-win/half-loss prior per pair; matching single-task arm anchored1500
elo_scope: study-local four-contender table including ridge; separate from historical eight-method panel ratings
bootstrap: 1000 paired family-cluster resamples with replacement, preserving all three seeds and arm pairings; percentile95% intervals
decision: CV Elo delta of joint minus matching single; no blended task statistic
JOINT_OK: both tasks: delta>=-25 OR confidence interval includes0
SPLIT_RECOMMENDED: same task delta<-25 and95%CI excludes0 at both last two consecutive evaluations
MITIGATE_AND_RERUN: otherwise; preregister one heads/loss-weighting mitigation rerun, retain original evidence
resume: no implicit restart; new attempt requires explicit unchanged campaign-budget accounting
